old_findings.note: copy whiles 7 -> 1 and mint's second safeTransferFrom is now 'call address(_to).transferFrom(...)' with its arguments; one Error(string) re-encoding loop remains (removeAsset's strategy branch, 1254)

improvements: P6 11 -> 0, P2 2 -> 0, copy whiles 7 -> 1. The SafeERC20/functionCall tails of mint, setStrategy and removeAsset are early reverts with decoded strings ('SafeERC20: low-level call failed', 'OTV1B: ERR removing collateral token', 'OTV1B: ERR removing MEM token') instead of re-encoding loops. The two token calls after copies are named (transferFrom, approve). The mint path's two SafeMath overflow checks use SafeMath.add, and Transfer/Minted/StrategySet have named fields. Initialized is no longer mis-decoded: the old text showed name as one Array spanning both strings and symbol as an offset, the new prints the exact ABI words (caller, 224, ceil32(name_.length) + 256, ...).
notes: Diff 707 lines, 4 changed functions (removeAsset, setStrategy, mint, init) reviewed by skeleton comparison and the changed regions read in full. Checked by disassembly: the 35-byte literal 'ICHIERC20: mint to the zero address' lies in the code's data section and is copied with CODECOPY of exactly 35 bytes, so the trailing 'mem[mem[64] + 103 len 29]' in the decoded revert (and 'mem[mem[64] + 110 len 22]' after the 42-byte SafeERC20 string) is exact, not lost zeros.
summary: No regression: copy loops 7 -> 1, every SafeERC20 tail decoded, calls after copies named, P2/P6 gone, and Initialized's misleading decoding replaced by the exact ABI words.
